263570|954d4e6d.name: Creeg Bothunk
263570|954d4e6d.text: Greetings, traveler! I am Creeg Bothunk, the main supplier for the Darkspear Raiders.  As you improve your standing with the  Darkspear Raiders, I will be able to provide a selection of goods that you can use inside Darkspear Islands.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

3033|8fca8484.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

96130-complete.text: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.

97927-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
97927-accept.text:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97927-accept.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97927-complete.name: Kray
97927-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Mana Well. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97927-complete.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97931-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
97931-accept.text:

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
